descriptor.grid: feature[j,i] centered at native pixel indices [4*j,4*i]
descriptor.mask: birth-independent original feature usability AND >=.8 valid site coverage AND nonzero vector
descriptor.site_discovery_history: At causal discovery, pool that image-derived site over archived prior available images; no future image evidence; shared decoder suppresses all events before birth
descriptor.distance: cosine to renormalized coordinate median of last<=3 usable unit descriptors
descriptor.state_update: current ordinary spatial probability when distance>=threshold; otherwise hold previous state
descriptor.initial_state: first usable observation initializes from its ordinary spatial probability
descriptor.decoder: existing shared two supporting usable observations /20day dwell /quality abstention
descriptor.selection: one global DEVELOPMENT distance/decoder point; macro event F1 at62day horizon; tie:ordinary macro F1 then lower distance threshold then lower decoder threshold
descriptor.confirmation: no confirmation outcomes until threshold and all source/data/model identities frozen
